tasks.label: SEA: levantar BD (docker)
tasks.command: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml up -d db

tasks.label: SEA: psql (consola de la BD)
tasks.command: docker exec -it sea-db psql -U sea_app -d sea

tasks.label: SEA: estado de las migraciones Flyway
tasks.command: docker exec sea-db psql -U sea_app -d sea -c 'select version, description, success, installed_on from flyway_schema_history order by installed_rank;'

tasks.label: SEA: recrear BD desde cero
tasks.command: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml down -v && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml up -d db
tasks.detail: BORRA el volumen de la BD y vuelve a aplicar todas las migraciones.
